I couldn't write these notes. Your rules say I can only report what the approved sites actually say, and I wasn't able to read any of them.

**What happened:**
- My first batch of searches crashed because my code misread the format of the search results.
- I sent one more test search to check that format, but the tool refused to run it because I had used up this turn's allowance.
- I never got to read a single page from enduringword.com, biblehub.com, studylight.org, preceptaustin.org or any other site on your list. My other tools can't reach the internet.

I could write general notes on Psalm 117 from memory, but you've asked me not to fill gaps from my own knowledge, and I wouldn't have real web addresses to back each point. So I've written nothing rather than give you notes without verified sources.

**Next time:** if you send the request again, I'll search the approved sites first. I plan to start with Enduring Word, Gill, Ellicott and the Pulpit Commentary, Spurgeon's *Treasury of David*, Precept Austin, the NET Bible notes and Augustine on New Advent. I'll also look for comment on Paul's use of verse 1 in Romans 15:11, since that's where most sources discuss the psalm's call to the Gentiles. Then I'll write the verse-by-verse notes with the web address after each point. Alternatively, you could paste in the text of particular commentary pages and I'll write the notes from those.
